title: Prologue: Requesting a Nailist
content: In my class, there’s a girl who seems almost otherworldly.
She’s friendly to everyone, bright, always smiling, and constantly surrounded by friends—truly a girl that makes you question if she’s even human.
“So, like, that shoot was totally insane!”
“No way!” “You’re exaggerating!”
“I’m serious! It was seriously amazing!”
Her vocabulary consists of only “insane,” “amazing,” and “seriously.”
Yet, people flock to her, naturally making her the center of our class, completing the circle.
A circle. In other words, a Community Circle.
In any community circle, there’s always a girl who can be the center—my classmate, Sayori Goto.
She sits comfortably at the diagonal desk, crossing her legs while repeating her “totally insane” stories.
How can she be so bright and remain at the center of everyone’s attention?
(I just don’t get it…)
I—Hajime Azuma—am not good at drawing attention. I’m also not good at conversation. In other words, I struggle with socializing.
The only thing I’m good at is making Plastic Models.
I can’t believe I’m the same species as Sayori Goto.
(Well, I don’t have horns, scales, or a tail…)
Strictly speaking, it’s hard to say Sayori Goto is the same “human.”
From her dyed blonde hair, curved golden horns protrude.
From a skirt that makes you worry about whether her underwear is showing, a long, thick tail snakes out, swaying at the tip.
There are slight scales around her eyes and hands. I’ve heard that she used to have scales all over her body.
She has the characteristics of a dragon often seen in games. Sayori Goto is a “Subhuman” with dragon-like features all over her body.
Well, there was a time when “Subhumans” faced discrimination, but now, if you say something like that, you’ll be labeled a bigot and treated as less than human.
Humans tend to draw lines between themselves.
The flawless, center-of-the-class gal, Sayori Goto, is indeed a different kind of human than I am.
(Wait, are they talking about a photo shoot…?)
The loud voice I hear seems to be about a fashion magazine shoot.
Sayori Goto is said to model for a fashion magazine aimed at Subhumans.
I’ve never read a fashion magazine, so I don’t know, but I can imagine she’s the center of attention among women.
Even though the clothes are the main focus, I think it would be a bit scary to have your face in a magazine. If it were something I made, that would be different—but still…
“Hey, Azuma!”
As I ponder this, I’m suddenly addressed from the opposite side. It’s my friend, Miyabe, sitting next to me.
“Azuma, I saw it! Your model was in a magazine!”
“Oh, yeah. I didn’t do that well… It’s my fourth time being in a magazine.”
“No way! It was so cool! The parts that were rusted didn’t look like a Plastic Model at all!”
“Well, I focused on the texture… I messed up a bit with the weathering.”
Even with familiar friends, I mumble gloomily. Ah, I’m such an introvert.
My hobby is making Plastic Models. I borrow part of my father’s garage to create, modify, and paint models.
Miyabe is probably talking about the model I submitted to the magazine.
I self-deprecate about my nerdy hobby, but I still enjoy it, and it doesn’t feel bad to be complimented.
Just as I was thinking that…
“Hey, hey!”
Before I knew it, Sayori Goto had approached my desk.
She leans in, making eye contact. Whoa, her eyelashes are so long! Her makeup is incredible!
And this is the first time we’re talking—
“Were you talking about magazines and modeling just now!? Did you buy my magazine!?”
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vB76FBF.jpeg
“Huh? No, um, just—”

“OMG, the latest shoot was seriously insane! Even though it’s winter, I had to wear bare legs, and I thought I was gonna freeze to death! Then my model friend was like, ‘You’re a dragon, aren’t you cold?’ Can you believe that!? Do they think I’m gonna breathe fire or something!? Do you read magazines like that, Azuma-kun!?”
“Wait, wait, wait…”
She doesn’t stop talking. Why is she so close to me when we’ve never even talked before?
I try to explain, but her face is too close, and I can’t come up with a proper response.
“Sayori, it’s different. We’re talking about Plastic Models.”
Miyabe throws me a lifeline.
He can talk about anime and models too, but he has decent social skills, so he can hold a conversation with someone like Sayori Goto.
He’s completely different from me, who stumbles over my words.
“Plastic Models!? Azuma-kun, you make Plastic Models?”
“Uh, yeah… just a little…”
Why is she so interested?
“That’s so cool! Show me, show me!”
“I-I don’t have any here—just in my garage at home.”
“Don’t you have photos on your phone!?”
“I borrowed my parents’ DSLR to take pictures…”
My smartphone’s camera quality is way too low.
“Oh, I see. That’s too bad…”
“Um, why are you so—”
“Eh!? Because I want to see them! You can make amazing models since you’re in a magazine, right!?”
When a girl who’s modeling in a magazine says that to me, it sounds like a high-level joke.
“Sayori, Sayori. Azuma is surprised.”
Miyabe, seeing my discomfort, speaks up to Sayori.
“Oh, right! Sorry! I shouldn’t have brought it up so suddenly!”
“N-No, it’s fine—”
“Let’s talk again sometime! Bye-bye!”
Sayori spins around like the wind and heads back to her group of girls.
Even though I knew the hole in her skirt was for her thick dragon tail, just seeing a hole in her skirt makes my heart race.
Anyway, swaying her tail, Sayori returns to the circle of girls.
I realize I had been holding my breath in nervousness during our conversation and finally take a deep breath.
“That was quite the bombardment.”
Miyabe chuckles as he pats my shoulder.
“W-Why did she suddenly…!?”
“Maybe she was interested in Plastic Models?”
“She’s a gal, right? That’s impossible!”
“Not really. Gals watch anime and play games too.”
“Even so, Plastic Models—”
“Well, there might be a reason behind it. She was really interested, so she can’t be completely uninterested.”
I tried to imagine Sayori Goto using nippers to make a model, but I couldn’t picture it well.
Her long nails don’t seem suited for delicate work anyway.
“Well, if you get another chance, why not tell her more about it? Azuma.”
“If there is one—”
After all, Sayori Goto will probably forget that she even talked to me the next moment.
She’s a gal, and I’m an introverted modeler. We have no connection, and even if we did, it would be fleeting.
We’re different kinds of humans who don’t mesh.
I thought that was the case, yet—
A few days after my first conversation with Sayori Goto, I would learn the “reason” that Miyabe mentioned.
“Azuma-kun, do my nails!”
Sayori Goto, who had called me to the rooftop, suddenly said that to me.
“I heard that since I’m a dragon, my nails are super strong! No matter which nail salon I go to, they break the tools or the polish doesn’t stick!”
Polish? I don’t even understand the terminology.
“I’ve been banned from all the nail salons in the neighborhood; it’s seriously hilarious, right!? No, it’s not funny at all; it’s a real crisis!”
I can’t keep up with Sayori Goto’s energy.
“Wait, I’m not good at nails at all—”
“Isn’t nail art kind of similar to Plastic Models? You file and paint them!”
“Huh?”
I’ve definitely heard something like that before.
But isn’t that just saying that the surface treatment and painting processes of models are similar to nail painting?
I don’t think they use the same techniques—
“Please! Azuma-kun!”
The light gal, who I thought I’d never have a connection with, puts her hands together in prayer.
I could see her nails—golden nails that are different from a human’s, dull and shining.
Even without nail art, Sayori Goto’s dragon nails look beautiful enough.
“Will you do my nails!?”
“Uh, um…”
I thought I should refuse.
But seeing Sayori Goto desperately bowing her head, I couldn’t bring myself to say those words.
“C-Could you tell me a bit more about it first?”
Even though I knew I couldn’t do nails, those words slipped out naturally.
Introverts can’t say no when they’re strongly asked.
“Really!? Thank you, Azuma-kun!”
Even though I hadn’t agreed yet, Sayori Goto’s face lit up.
Ah—though I’ve never done nails before, I thought I couldn’t betray that smile.
Thus began my first request from the Dragon Girl to become her Nailist.
